name: desktop-project-work-local
goal: Expose the committed project Work snapshot to the local Electron renderer without widening remote access.

evidence: The Work backend exposes projectWork for a selected project, but Electron preload and the local wire method catalog omit it; a local renderer cannot request its committed feature snapshot.

The existing local socket bridge case covers other project operations but never requests projectWork; extend that same method case and verify local-only permission without changing established behavior.
b2082a8dc9d05d70d727e14c663e675205dbe4036068e9b1e00c6911c934a1c7: local transport reports the projectWork operation does not exist at the committed test revision.
Added projectWork to local-only wire methods and exposed it from the Electron preload; local selection checks remain in the existing bridge.
